summary: A three-minute demo has about six beats, shows only what you have run, and says plainly what is a stand-in. You run every beat for real, write the script and count its words, list what can fail on stage with a fallback for each, and write a 150-word portfolio story with one decision and its evidence and one thing that broke.

items.text: Run every beat of your demo for real from a clean start and write down what each shows
Write the script in six beats and count the spoken words
Read it aloud with a timer and compare with your prediction
Write what can go wrong on stage and a one-line fallback for each
Write your portfolio story in about 150 words with the six parts
Play the Demo Check game to the end and see your score
